title: Toy · companions bred small
blurb: The lap dogs: bred down from working and temple dogs until the whole animal fits on a cushion, with the temperament left intact.

items.d: The smallest breed, 15–23 cm, from northern Mexico and named after a state.
German spitz descendant, 18–24 cm, reduced from a sled dog to a portable ball of coat.
Chinese companion dog of the Han court, 25–33 cm, with a curled tail and a wheezing charm.
Victorian mill-worker's ratting terrier, now 2–3 kg of silk coat and attitude.
Mediterranean lap dog over two thousand years old: pure white, 2–4 kg, and no undercoat.
Tibetan temple dog bred for the Chinese court: 20–28 cm, long hair and a flat face.
French toy spaniel named for its butterfly ears; small, bright and one of the oldest toy types.
English toy spaniel of 5.5–8 kg, restored in the 1920s from the Stuart court dogs.
